recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to white (#FFFFFF) and draw a thin dark-red (#B22222) rectangle outline inset slightly from all four slide edges as the frame.
2. Draw a light-gray (#E8E8E8) header band rectangle across the full slide width, covering roughly the top 0-15% of slide height.
3. Inside the header band, centered horizontally, place one line of bold sans-serif title text: 'Nearest Neighbors' in dark red (#B22222) followed on the same line by '(NN) Outlier Problem' in blue (#0000CC), with a single space between the two segments.
4. At the top-right of the header band, draw a yellow (#FFF9C4) circle with a dark outline, containing centered dark (#333333) text '46'.
5. In the left body area (~10-48% width, ~20-85% height), draw dark-red (#B22222) L-shaped axes: a vertical line with an up arrowhead and a horizontal line with a right arrowhead meeting at the lower-left; no ticks, no axis labels.
6. In the left panel, scatter ~10 green (#7CFC00) filled circles as a cluster in the left/middle area.
7. In the left panel, scatter ~9 cyan (#00E5E5) filled circles as a cluster in the upper-right area.
8. In the left panel, scatter ~6 tan/beige (#F5DEB3) filled circles as a cluster in the bottom-center area.
9. Centered under the left panel in the footer band (~88-95% height), place bold dark-red (#B22222) sans-serif caption text 'Data of Three Classes'.
10. In the right body area (~52-92% width, ~20-85% height), duplicate the dark-red L-shaped axes from step 5.
11. In the right panel, duplicate the three clusters from steps 6-8 in the same relative positions: ~10 green circles left/middle, ~9 cyan circles upper-right, ~6 tan circles bottom-center.
12. Over the green cluster in the right panel, draw a translucent yellow (#FFFF99) irregular freeform blob enclosing the green cluster's points.
13. Draw a yellow ring around the green point at the top-right edge of the green cluster, inside the yellow blob.
14. Place a solid red (#FF0000) filled circle (the outlier) just to the right of the ringed green point from step 13.
15. Draw ~15 thin light-red lines: one from the red outlier point to each of the ~9 cyan points and one to each of the ~6 tan points.
16. Add small red arrow markers on points of the right panel (exact count unspecified [?]).
17. Draw a small green (#7CFC00) plus-sign '+' marker inside the yellow blob.
18. At the top-left of the right panel, just above the plot area, draw a small rectangle with light-green fill (#E8F5E9) and green (#4CAF50) border, containing two stacked lines of small dark sans-serif text: 'Outlier' on line 1 and 'Sample' on line 2.
19. Draw a thin gray pointer line from the label box (step 18) to the red outlier point (step 14).
20. Centered under the right panel in the footer band (~88-95% height), place bold dark-red (#B22222) sans-serif caption text 'Nearest Neighbor is the Green class'.
